news.title: New minor risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 75% of Indian stocks, typically moving 7.0% a week. This is considered a minor risk. Share price volatility indicates the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. It also increases the risk of potential losses in the short term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. news.title: Kabra Drugs Limited Approves Reconstitution of Board and Committees, Effective November 13, 2025
news.body: Kabra Drugs Limited approved the reconstitution of the composition of the Board and Committees of the Board with effect from November 13, 2025. The newly structured Board of Directors includes Nanjappan Aravind as the Executive Director and Managing Director, Kuniamuthur Nanjappan Anand as an Executive Director, Anand Anitha as a Non-Executive Independent Director and Chairperson, Ritu Tiwari as a Non-Executive Independent Director, and Nikita Sinha as a Non-Executive Independent Director. The Audit Committee is chaired by Nikita Sinha, Non-Executive - Independent Director with Anand Anitha, Non-Executive - Independent Director and Kuniamuthur Nanjappan Anand,Executive Director serving as members.
